info.title: PreCallAI Universal API
info.description: PreCallAI helps teams build, manage, and run AI voice-call workflows with assistants, dialers, segments, campaigns, and call playground tooling.

post.description: Bulk uploads segment contacts in PreCallAI.

success.description: Whether the bulk upload request succeeded.
